title: C link-layer dio_time_option_decode accepts trailing bytes (diverges from Python/Rust exact-8)
description: Pre-existing, found by ndk7 codereview: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c:636 lichen_dio_time_option_decode rejects only buflen < 8, accepting trailing bytes, while python DioTimeOption.decode (timing/samples.py:147) and rust DioTimeOption::from_bytes (time_option.rs:89) require exactly 8. Also mutates the output struct before the NO_SYNC/timestamp validation (same atomicity issue fixed in lichen_rpl_dio_time_parse this round). Fix both to match the strict codecs; no in-repo callers found so it is dormant.
